description: Closed value-type registry frozen for the first Week 2 HybridQA planner experiment.

Table.description: A complete HybridQA table with an ordered declared column schema.

RowSet.description: A collection of table rows; v0.2 does not grant a stable ranking contract.

EntitySet.description: A collection of linked entity identities.

Document.description: One locally linked HybridQA document or passage.

DocumentSet.description: A collection of locally linked documents or passages.

String.description: Text that has not been implicitly parsed as another type.

Number.description: A numeric value produced by typed extraction, explicit parsing, aggregation, or arithmetic.

Date.description: A date value produced by typed extraction or explicit parsing.

Boolean.description: A true or false comparison result.

ValueSet.description: A homogeneous scalar collection whose member type is tracked by the producing operator's output rule, not encoded in the base type string.
